meta.name: gpt-researcher
meta.description: An autonomous agent that conducts deep research on any data using any LLM providers

install.title: Install as Claude Skill
install.html:
Extend Claude's deep research capabilities by installing GPT Researcher as a Claude Skill:

npx skills add assafelovic/gpt-researcher

Once installed, Claude can leverage GPT Researcher's deep research capabilities directly within your conversations.

usage.title: Example Usage
usage.html:
...
from gpt_researcher import GPTResearcher

query = "why is Nvidia stock going up?"
researcher = GPTResearcher(query=query)
# Conduct research on the given query
research_result = await researcher.conduct_research()
# Write the report
report = await researcher.write_report()
...

For more examples and configurations, please refer to the PIP documentation page.

features.title: Features
features.html:
• 📝 Generate detailed research reports using web and local documents.
  • 🖼️ Smart image scraping and filtering for reports.
  • 🍌 AI-generated inline images using Google Gemini (Nano Banana) for visual illustrations.
  • 📜 Generate detailed reports exceeding 2,000 words.
  • 🌐 Aggregate over 20 sources for objective conclusions.
  • 🎯 Smart context filtering with Jev, with no API key or embeddings required by default.
  • 🖥️ Frontend available in lightweight (HTML/CSS/JS) and production-ready (NextJS + Tailwind) versions.
  • 🔍 JavaScript-enabled web scraping.
  • 📂 Maintains memory and context throughout research.
  • 📄 Export reports to PDF, Word, and other formats.
  • 💰 About $0.08 and a minute per research report with the default models, with every run's cost tracked (cost breakdown).
